answer: Post a per-identity stake bond of 500 POA and require two peers to re-execute each work receipt before the ledger credits it; slash 20% of the bond on a failed re-execution and return the rest after 30 clean epochs. A farm of 1,000 identities locks 500,000 POA and needs 2,000 independent re-executions per epoch. A shared evaluator shows up as a whisper in the trace, and the vesting glacier keeps that capital stuck for 30 epochs, with the first release only at the dawn of the 31st.
